configuration.systemPrompt: Play Hangman. Choose one unused English letter to solve the hidden word before six misses. The pattern uses _ for unknown positions. A hit reveals ALL occurrences, so guessed letters cannot occur in blanks. Hits cost nothing; misses cost one chance. Return exactly one ASCII letter A-Z, with no explanation, punctuation or word guess.
configuration.sampling: seeded round-robin over shuffled length × rarity strata; pilot, not population-weighted

budget.scope: local I7a runs today; excludes other account usage; token-derived estimates, not billed neurons
